      <h2>Core Services</h2>
      <div class="grid">
        <div class="card"><h3>Heavy Haulage</h3><p>Transportation of heavy, oversized, industrial and commercial cargo using suitable fleet assets and route planning.</p></div>
        <div class="card"><h3>Abnormal Load Transport</h3><p>Movement of oversized or irregular loads requiring planning, access review, timing coordination and safe handling.</p></div>
        <div class="card"><h3>Lifting Operations</h3><p>Support for lifting, loading, offloading and positioning cargo or equipment where specialized handling is required.</p></div>
        <div class="card"><h3>Freight Coordination</h3><p>Planning and coordination for cargo movement, including Trinidad-to-Miami freight gateway support where applicable.</p></div>
        <div class="card"><h3>Standby Transport</h3><p>Rapid-response standby units for time-sensitive industrial, port, construction or commercial transport needs.</p></div>
        <div class="card"><h3>Industrial Logistics</h3><p>Logistics support for projects involving machinery, site movement, cargo staging, dispatch coordination and delivery planning.</p></div>
      </div>

    <section id="safety">
      <h2>Safety & Operations Standards</h2>
      <p>AMCOL Haulage emphasizes safe transport planning, secure cargo handling, dispatch coordination, route awareness, equipment readiness and communication with customer site representatives. For abnormal or oversized loads, operational planning may include review of access points, restrictions, dispatch timing, cargo characteristics and on-site coordination needs.</p>
    </section>

    <section id="faq">
      <h2>Frequently Asked Questions</h2>
      <h3>What is heavy haulage?</h3>
      <p>Heavy haulage is the transport of large, heavy, oversized or industrial cargo using appropriate vehicles, route planning and secure handling methods.</p>
      <h3>Does AMCOL Haulage serve all of Trinidad and Tobago?</h3>
      <p>Yes. AMCOL Haulage provides nationwide transport and logistics support across Trinidad and Tobago.</p>
      <h3>Can AMCOL move oversized cargo?</h3>
      <p>AMCOL supports abnormal and oversized load movement subject to route access, cargo dimensions, site requirements and operational planning.</p>
      <h3>How do customers submit a request?</h3>
      <p>Customers can submit a service request using the online request form or contact the AMCOL operations hotline.</p>
      <h3>What information helps AMCOL prepare a quote?</h3>
      <p>Helpful details include company name, contact person, pickup location, delivery location, requested dispatch time, cargo type, estimated weight, handling notes, site restrictions and direct phone contact.</p>
    </section>
